messages: October 5 snapshot archived for historical reference. Its content, market values, source timestamps and user commentary are preserved.
ES and NQ have 920 of 920 eligible futures minute bars; YM has 907 and RTY has 914. Missing minute buckets limit the YM and RTY observed ranges.
VIX has 239 published one-minute bars from 04:00 through 09:19 ET; its high and low use observed bars only. TradingView warns that historical bars may be delayed 15+ minutes.
OpenMarket CME prices cannot be shared with the agent under its exchange license. Hyperliquid index proxies were not used for these canonical futures levels.

SPY and QQQ premarket values use Robinhood extended-hours bars from 04:00 through 09:19 ET. Ranges include only non-interpolated, positive-volume bars: 197 SPY and 278 QQQ traded minutes were returned out of 320 possible minutes.

VIX and Treasury yields use TradingView one-minute bars through 09:19 ET. TradingView warns historical bars may be delayed 15+ minutes; observed window coverage was 239 VIX, 243 2Y, 255 5Y, 266 10Y and 281 30Y bars.
Public.com returned UNKNOWN for the Treasury yield symbols; the approved TradingView fallback supplied timestamped tenor observations.

indices.title: Equity Commentary
indices.body:
Oil is trading at around $90, above the $88 key technical level. While oil exports have rebounded strongly since the start of the war, higher freight costs and risk premium have kept prices stubbornly elevated.

The market continues to spike into new ATHs and with volatile follow-through. Breadth is still poor, with tech noticeably strong. Industrials and consumer discretionary remain the only non-tech sectors where roughly at least 30% of member stocks trade over the 20DMA. The rate story, uncertainty around midterms and the potential for an Iran deal continue to be primary drivers of price action.

bonds.title: Bond Commentary
bonds.body:
Personally I'm of the opinion that Treasury yields will chill out in the short term and will prove to be a weak headwind against equities.

Overseas, there have been rising concerns about France's national debt - with French bond yields the highest in 24 years.
